verdict.rationale: The product is itself a set of agent-oriented markdown files. Each SKILL.md is reachable at a raw GitHub URL (e.g. tdd, grilling, triage, setup) with frontmatter and agent-directed instructions, and the install path was verified hands-on to deliver those files to an agent. However, there is no evidence of an llms.txt or an agent-oriented index of the docs, and the probe for a markdown docs endpoint returned 404. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, a documented agent-readable docs entry point (the skills.md probe 404'd), and independent corroboration of pointing an agent at the docs.
